details.description: Dark mode toggle does not change the background and text colors of the main container.
details.fix_explanation: Conditionally apply bg-gray-900 and text-white when darkMode is true.

details.description: Button styling does not adapt to dark mode.
details.fix_explanation: Conditionally apply border and text colors for dark mode.
details.before:
<button
        className="mb-4 px-2 py-1 border"
        onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
      >
details.after:
<button
        className={`mb-4 px-2 py-1 border ${darkMode ? 'border-white text-white' : 'border-black text-black'}`}
        onClick={() => setDarkMode(!darkMode)}
      >

details.description: No loading state shown while metrics are being fetched.
details.fix_explanation: Added loading state and conditional rendering to show 'Loading...' until data is loaded.
details.before:
{metrics.map((m, i) => (
{m.label}
{m.value}
))}
details.after:
{loading ? (
Loading...
) : ( metrics.map((m, i) => (
{m.label}
{m.value}
)) )}

details.description: Grid layout is not responsive on smaller screens.
details.fix_explanation: Changed to grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 for better responsiveness.
